profile.Civilian Name: Asher Lim; Lín Ruì Qí (林瑞祺); Lucas Lee (Biological Name); Lǐ Jié Ruì 李捷瑞 (Chinese Biological Name)
profile.Civilian Appearance: Asher is tall with a lean, well-built frame, dark hair, and expressive eyes. His facial features bear a noticeable resemblance to Lumina's, although their different builds, hairstyles, and mannerisms make them easy to distinguish. He prefers practical, comfortable clothing and generally carries himself with a relaxed but observant demeanour. His expressions are more readable than Lumina's, particularly when annoyed, confused, or amused.
profile.Awakening Type: Self-Awakened (Blossom’s power was introduced during the awakening process)
profile.Transformation Item: Clover Wrist Cuff (When deactivated, it's just a silver band)
profile.Passed Tests: Planned — Attacker, Support (Barrier, Field Healer, Researcher), Strategist
profile.Signature Ability: Planned — Clover's Foundation; Clover reinforces the ground and existing structures using Earth magic, improving their stability and resistance to damage. His ability is particularly useful during evacuations, rescue missions, and situations involving damaged buildings. His knowledge of structural engineering allows him to recognise vulnerable areas and apply magical reinforcement more efficiently.
profile.Strengths: Adaptability, observation, problem-solving, structural knowledge, practical judgement, resourcefulness, loyalty, quick thinking, and remaining composed during unfamiliar situations.
profile.Weaknesses: Clover can become argumentative when he disagrees with someone's reasoning, especially if he believes their explanation makes little sense. Although observant and cautious, he can be stubborn once he has reached a conclusion. His inherited Fire also introduces additional Core complexity that requires careful monitoring and training.
profile.Fear: Losing the family and relationships he has only recently gained, or discovering that his unstable inherited power could endanger them.
profile.Mentor: Luma Blossom; Luma EmberFlora is not officially registered.
profile.Relationship: Single; later develops a romantic relationship with Luma EmberFlora (Sylvia).
profile.Family: Lumina's missing fraternal twin, believed to have died at birth. Both his biological and adoptive fathers are deceased. He has two older biological siblings, both married with two children each.
profile.Close bonds: Luma Blossom (Lumina), Luma EmberFlora (Sylvia); members of Wildflowers.
profile.Rivals: Friendly sibling rivalry with Luma Blossom.
profile.Loves: Feeling included, spending time with loved ones, meaningful acts of affection, and the sense of belonging he gradually develops with his biological family.
profile.Likes: Practical problem-solving, clever jokes, quiet company, friendly teasing, exploring interesting places, and learning how things work.
profile.Dislikes: Unreasonable instructions, poor explanations, being underestimated, unnecessary restrictions, and people making assumptions about him.
profile.Hates: Manipulation, cruelty, betrayal of trust, and people deliberately putting others in danger.
profile.Hobbies: Gaming, exploring new cafés, building or designing things, solving puzzles, and trying new activities with friends.
profile.Personality: Asher is clever, observant, and adaptable, with an independent personality and a dry, playful sense of humour. He prefers understanding situations before acting and readily questions explanations that seem unreasonable. Although generally practical and composed, his emotions are surprisingly easy to read when he is annoyed or caught off guard, making him more reactive than his twin sister Lumina. He enjoys harmless mischief and deliberately provoking reactions from people he trusts, particularly Lumina, whom he frequently teases simply because he finds her irritation entertaining. Despite his mischievous side, Asher is deeply loyal and quietly affectionate, expressing concern through small, thoughtful actions rather than dramatic declarations. Around Sylvia, his playful and more vulnerable sides emerge naturally, while her warmth and enthusiasm help him become more comfortable expressing affection. Although he values his independence, he gradually learns to accept the support and belonging offered by his newfound family and teammates.
Personality Example: When Lumina is concentrating on something important, Asher occasionally makes a deliberately irritating comment just to see her reaction. He often maintains a completely innocent expression while she becomes increasingly annoyed.

Around Sylvia, Asher may complain about her excessive enthusiasm or affection but rarely makes any genuine effort to move away. He often ends up helping her with whatever activity she has decided to pursue.

When someone gives an unclear explanation, Asher immediately asks questions until he understands the reasoning. His directness can make him appear argumentative, even when he is genuinely trying to help.

During a mission involving structural damage, Asher quickly identifies a safer approach based on his engineering experience, showing that his civilian skills are valuable even before he becomes an experienced Guardian.
profile.Fever Behaviour: Asher becomes unusually affectionate and emotionally expressive toward everyone when feverish. He frequently seeks hugs, leans against whoever is nearby, and openly expresses his appreciation for those around him. His usual playful teasing is replaced by genuine sweetness, making him surprisingly endearing. He becomes less mindful of personal space and may even refuse to let go of someone he is hugging. Once recovered, he remembers little of his behaviour and becomes terribly embarrassed when others bring it up.
profile.Intoxicated Behaviour: Asher becomes extremely sociable, energetic, and affectionate when intoxicated. His usual playful personality becomes even more exaggerated, often initiating ridiculous games, hugging everyone, and enthusiastically declaring how much he loves them. He becomes particularly attached to Lumina, repeatedly reminding her that they're twins and insisting that she loves him, even when she refuses to admit it. His sense of personal space practically disappears, and he becomes increasingly dramatic whenever someone rejects his affection.
profile.Background:
Luma Clover is a Capricorn-born Guardian with Earth as his natural element and the missing fraternal twin of Luma Blossom. Believed to have died at birth, Asher grew up separately from his biological family and later became a structural engineer, unaware of his connection to Lumina or the Guardian world.
In December 2025, Asher's Earth Core self-awakened during a dangerous incident involving hostile creatures. Shortly afterward, an enemy forcibly introduced stored Fire magic originating from Blossom into his newly awakened Core, leaving him with an unstable Fire inheritance. He was found unconscious by Blossom and EmberFlora, who noticed his remarkable resemblance to Lumina. EmberFlora subsequently helped stabilise his Core during his recovery.
Asher eventually learns about his Guardian abilities and his connection to Lumina. Under Blossom's mentorship, he begins developing his Earth magic while learning to manage his inherited Fire. He joins Wildflowers and gradually builds relationships with his newfound family and teammates, particularly Sylvia, with whom he later develops a romantic relationship.
